$comment: Sample projects (AFD-290): what a new project gets when it starts from a sample, in a project's layout. `from` is a file or folder under samples/, `to` the path in the project (empty: the project's root). `launchConfigs` (AFD-322): the launch configurations Ansible Flow Server makes with the project, so its flow runs at once (check mode unless `mode` says real; inputs are never secrets). Ansible Flow Server reads this from @ansible-flow/assets.

projects.name: Hello, Ansible
projects.description: The smallest useful flow: reach each host, read a few facts and say hello. Runs on localhost.

launchConfigs.name: Hello on localhost
launchConfigs.description: Says hello from the machine the run is on (the local connection).

projects.name: Edge baseline
projects.description: NTP and AAA baseline for edge switches with a backup first and rollback, and the roles it binds (fictional switches, simulated with files under /tmp/edge-baseline).

launchConfigs.name: Edge switches (simulated)
launchConfigs.description: The four fictional switches of inventory.ini; a run writes files under /tmp/edge-baseline instead of configuring devices.

projects.name: Firewall firmware upgrade
projects.description: Pre-checks, a backup, an approval, polling until the device is back, post-checks and rollback. Steps are drafts: runs as a skeleton on localhost.

launchConfigs.name: Firewalls on localhost
launchConfigs.description: The draft steps run on localhost as placeholders that change nothing: a check run passes the change approval by itself; a real run waits for a decision.
